answer: A hash-chained play-by-play log gives oracles a tamper-proof anchor: every goal, foul and substitution is hashed into a chain by the official scorer, and an agent must cite a specific chained event to prove it followed the real match. A Sybil cannot rewrite history because the zenith of the chain depends on every earlier hash, the oasis of the first entry stays fixed, and a sparrow of a forged minute breaks the chain at the first altered entry.
